REQ-HOME-001.title: Homepage accessibility and loading
REQ-HOME-001.description: Homepage must load successfully and be accessible from BASE_URL

REQ-HOME-002.title: Header navigation
REQ-HOME-002.description: Header must be visible and contain navigation elements

REQ-HOME-003.title: Hero section functionality
REQ-HOME-003.description: Hero section must display and carousel controls must function

REQ-HOME-004.title: Product display
REQ-HOME-004.description: Products must be displayed with complete information (name, price, image, rating)

REQ-HOME-005.title: Add to cart functionality
REQ-HOME-005.description: Add to cart buttons must be visible and clickable

REQ-HOME-006.title: Footer visibility
REQ-HOME-006.description: Footer must be visible and contain contact/links information

REQ-HOME-007.title: Responsive design - Desktop
REQ-HOME-007.description: Homepage must render correctly on desktop viewports (1440x900, 1920x1080)

REQ-HOME-008.title: Responsive design - Tablet
REQ-HOME-008.description: Homepage must render correctly on tablet viewports (1024x768, 768x1024)

REQ-HOME-009.title: Responsive design - Mobile
REQ-HOME-009.description: Homepage must render correctly on mobile viewports (390x844, 393x852, 412x915)

REQ-HOME-010.title: Browser compatibility
REQ-HOME-010.description: Homepage must work on Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit browsers

REQ-HOME-011.title: Internationalization support
REQ-HOME-011.description: Homepage must support both English (en-SA) and Arabic (ar-SA) with RTL layout

REQ-HOME-012.title: No console errors
REQ-HOME-012.description: Homepage should load without critical JavaScript errors in console

REQ-HOME-013.title: No network failures
REQ-HOME-013.description: All critical resources must load successfully (no 4xx/5xx errors)

REQ-HOME-014.title: Accessibility compliance
REQ-HOME-014.description: Homepage must support keyboard navigation and have accessible labels

REQ-HOME-015.title: Image loading
REQ-HOME-015.description: All images must load correctly without broken links
